title: Vero
tagline: Vero is an Onchain derivative layer on top of Polymarket with dynamic leverage
description:
Prediction markets have a capital inefficiency problem. Polymarket processes billions in volume, but once you buy a position, that capital is locked:

No leverage — To get $1,000 of exposure, you need $1,000 of capital
Locked positions — Shares sit idle; they can't be used as collateral or composed with other protocols
No derivatives — There's no way to express leveraged, hedged, or structured views on prediction market outcomes
Capital stuck on one platform — Positions can't move into the broader DeFi ecosystem
The result: massive opportunity cost for traders and zero composability with the rest of on-chain finance.

The Solution
Vero builds on-chain futures on top of Polymarket outcomes
how_its_made:
Vero builds on-chain futures on top of Polymarket outcomes, executed on a fully decentralized orderbook (DeepBook V3) on Sui:

Leverage — Trade prediction market outcomes with up to 20x leverage, dramatically improving capital efficiency
On-chain execution via DeepBook V3 — Every order is a verifiable Sui transaction on a fully decentralized CLOB
Self-custodial — Users maintain control of funds through Sui wallets at all times
DeFi composability — On-chain positions can be used as collateral, hedged, or integrated with other Sui protocols
Real-time price discovery from Polymarket — Reference prices stream from Polymarket's liquid markets
